items.description: Your grocery list as mashup. Use a barcode scanner and this service to keep track of your running grocery list. Uses data from the UPC Database web service.

MapEcos is a map of US facilities with information on pollution and improvement efforts. Provides information for 23,000 facilities as well as data aggregated at company, industry, and geographic levels. Data from EPA.
The Daily Top Five list in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year presents a new top five list compiled from sports, music, films, society, and more.
Sightseeing popularity heatmaps for the whole world, based on Panoramio photos and FourSquare places.
YouTubeMP4 creates a link to the mpeg4 file on YouTube from the YouTube URL. You can download the file quickly by directly downloading it from YouTube.
It's a non-commercial city portal with a Google Mgap of Torun, a beatiful, medieval Polish town.

Mohiomap takes important documents and files in the Cloud and enables users to understand how they relate to one another and to visualize them in a way the brain understands. Starting with Evernote and Dropbox, Mohiomap provides a change of perspective on existing information - displaying it in a way which adds meaning and understanding.
Indeed job search integrated with Facebook and LinkedIn - find jobs close to friends, and see who you know (or contacts know) at those offering the job.
Tracks leads using a unique telephone number so that customers can be tracked when calling instead of just when they enter information into a website.

TalkRain “Social Call” helps users to call, capture and share. User can call their friend, at the end of the call they will presented with a shorten URL of the recording to share over their Social Network. TalkRain “Conference” helps users to call, capture and Upload. User can create conference with their customers, colleagues or anyone, at the end of the conference recordings will be uploaded to the Box.net.
Slick interactive visualization of the relationship between music artists using the Last.fm and Amazon.com.uk APIs. NOTE: As of Oct 2008, this site appears to have stopped operation.
Explore UK radio and television. Extensive search options. Uses data from BBC Backstage. Data available in multiple formats: RSS, iCal, JSON.
Feed for rappers on Twitter.
Tell Goal Prompt what your goals are and how you plan to achieve them, and we'll call you up with gentle reminders to take that next step.
Zenoss Core is an open source systems management platform that monitors your whole infrastructure. Starting with version 2.1, all geographical network data is overlaid on Google Maps.
Digital marketplace using modified BitTorrent network for distribution. Allows sellers to list their items, and Buyers to get paid for helping distribute.
Compare and buy dresses. Uses the Shopping.com API.

PixtaPlace is a service that lets you look at images from anywhere in the world. Locations are looked up via the Google Maps API and the photographs consist of recent photographs on Instagram and Flickr.

Web application for sailors and sea-lovers, a place to share your knowledge about the oceans of the world on a global map. Find critical information such as facilities, aids to navigation, dangers, commercial services, ocean conservation data, etc.
Service for you to collect, organize, and share information for shopping, travel or any other research.
Shows over 100,000 pilots on a map and where they are located.
